blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — A college professor who also makes music on the side has launched a book that compiles choral arrangements of lesser-known folk songs from Bicol to preserve the region’s musical heritage. Ramil “Plok” Chavenia, 59, launched the book on Saturday, Oct. 3, saying it was the product of a decade of collecting and researching Bicolano folk music. He said the book, “Bicol Folksongs” believed to be the first collection of choral arrangements in Albay, would serve as an accessible reference for teachers, singers and cultural workers.
